Packaging & print

A brand you can hold.

Packaging and print designed for the moment someone picks it up.

From the shelf to the small print.

The shape, information and visual language need to work together. We start with the product, the person using it and the conditions the packaging needs to meet.

Define the formats, dimensions, product range and production constraints. Share any dielines and supplier specifications before developing the artwork.

Set a clear hierarchy for the name, product details and information supplied by your business. Make the important parts easy to find at the scale they will be used.

Connect materials, colour and print treatments with the brand. Review production-ready artwork with the supplier and agree how samples will be checked.

A connected set of touchpoints.

Boxes, labels, inserts and print pieces should feel like parts of the same story. Bring a complete list of the formats your team needs.
